Title: Priority transition
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. Settings, Priorities now has a Change for next year button. For each pillar and sub-pillar you choose whether it continues, becomes another or ends, and the priorities follow by themselves, merges included. We could not reproduce the blank 2027 view you saw. If it appears again, please report it with a screenshot.
InternalNote: Year-change panel, tested on dev (R2 tests 3 to 6). The reported 2027 view with no pillar row was never reproduced; cause unknown.

Title: Adding pillars
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. When you add a pillar or sub-pillar in Settings, Priorities, the cursor now stays in the new row and the page no longer jumps to the bottom of the list. No action needed.
InternalNote: The cursor went to the last sub-pillar box in the whole list. Tested on dev (R2 test 1).

Title: Ingestion task - use keyboard not mouse for data entry
ReporterMessage: Thanks for the idea. It is now built. In an ingestion task's grid, Enter in a cell's editor sets the value and moves down a row, Shift+Enter sets it and moves up, and Escape cancels and puts the cursor back on the cell. Tab still moves across. In a notes cell, Enter makes a new line and Ctrl+Enter sets it.
InternalNote: Was Deferred in the v0.100.0 file; built in tranche 5 of the backlog programme. Tested on dev (tranche 5 test 7). Arrow-key movement between cells was offered and not chosen.

Title: Custom columms reset
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. The columns you choose in Documents are now yours. They stay when you tick or untick a library, open Favourites, or close and reopen the app, until you press Reset to default in Choose columns. A saved view or a shared link shows its own columns while it is open, and yours return when you close it.
InternalNote: A library change rebuilt the screen without the view, and columns were never saved for the person. Tested on dev (R6 test 1).

Title: Metal Delivery process areas incorrect
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Two process areas shared one name and the ingestion grid picked the wrong one. That is fixed, so no new documents will be tagged under the wrong area. The documents already tagged wrongly are still to be corrected by a document controller, using the Change properties tool that arrived in v0.101.0. Nothing for you to do.
InternalNote: Terms read by id since v0.100.0 (R1 test 6). Bulk change of properties shipped in v0.101.0 (R4 tests 3 to 5). STILL OWED by Ben: the BSL process-tree repair and the re-tagging.

Title: Larger arrows to expand filter menus
ReporterMessage: Thanks for the idea. The arrows that expand a branch in the Filters pane are now larger and easier to hit. Clicking a branch's name still ticks it as a filter, so only the arrow expands it. This shipped without being checked in the live app, so please tell us if the arrows are still hard to use.
InternalNote: Built in R6 with report 8; TO UAT, not seen running (UAT-DOC-119). Whole-row expand was dropped at the walk: it would have removed the click that ticks a filter.

Title: Default select all three doc libraries
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. Documents opens with the libraries you last had ticked, so tick all three once and it will open that way from then on. Select all on the Libraries card ticks every library, and clicking a library's name shows that one alone.
InternalNote: No build: the app remembers the last selection. The tooltip planned for R6 (Show only this library) already existed.

Title: Filter pane is small
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. The Filters pane in Documents now runs from under the Filters button to the bottom of the window and is wider, so long lists need less scrolling. This shipped without being checked in the live app. If the pane is still cramped on your screen, please tell us what size window you use.
InternalNote: Built in R6; TO UAT, not seen running (UAT-DOC-119): the pane in a short window, the foot buttons under a long list. A side panel and a pop-up window were out of scope.

Title: Condense libraries panel
ReporterMessage: Thanks for the idea. The Libraries card in Documents now folds to one line that says how many libraries are ticked. Press the small arrow by its heading. The app remembers whether you left it folded, and the folders list below gets the room it gives up.
InternalNote: Tested on dev (R6 test 3).

Title: Document tasks dashboard
ReporterMessage: Thanks for the idea. Document tasks now opens as a larger panel, and each row has its action: Approve or Request revision, Review complete, Check in or Discard, Mark reviewed. Each opens the same dialog as on the document, over the list, and the row leaves the list when it is done. Open is still on every row.
InternalNote: Tested on dev (R4 test 7). An approval can now be made without opening the document (Ben's choice); the dialog says what has not been seen.

Title: Documents open at the bottom
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. A document's preview now opens at page 1 instead of at the bottom. No action needed. If you still see a document open at the end, please tell us which one.
InternalNote: Cause not found; the preview now asks for page 1. Converted files only. Tested on dev (R1 test 7). Check in production after release.

Title: Evidence attachments for approvals on behalf
ReporterMessage: Thanks for the idea. When a document controller approves for someone else, the Approve dialog now asks On behalf of and offers Attach evidence. The history then names both people and shows the evidence on that version to anyone who can open it. This shipped without being checked in the live app, so please tell us how your first one goes.
InternalNote: Built in R4; TO UAT, not seen running (UAT-DOC-114): the evidence landing on the right version, the Teams card to the person approved for. Evidence is hidden by the app only; the table is readable in Dataverse.

Title: Reviews not marking as complete
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Review complete now records your review and the card shows it as done. Pressing it a second time in the same round is refused with a clear message, and each version's comment now shows under its row in the history. No action needed.
InternalNote: The review check read comments from one place; it now reads all three. Which place production uses is not known. Tested on dev (R1 test 3). Reviewer seats go to UAT untested.

Title: Completion of review
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. When a step is refused because the document is open in Word, the app now says so plainly and says who has it open. Close the document in Word, including any other tab, then press the button again.
InternalNote: Word's lock on an open file read as an app fault. Tested on dev (R1 test 4).

Title: Review status not updating
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. It was the same fault as another report and is now fixed: Review complete records the review and the status updates. The Teams message to the next person now also sends by itself, with no second press needed.
InternalNote: Same fault as report 13, plus the hand-over message. Tested on dev (R1 tests 3 and 5).

Title: I declined an edit request and now the document is checked out to me
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. If a step is refused part-way, the app now gives back the check-out it took, so the document is not left checked out to you, and it says that nothing was changed. We have not yet found why the step was refused in the first place. If it happens again, please send us the message word for word.
InternalNote: Release of a taken check-out is unit-tested only; it could not be forced on dev. Why Approve failed on the edit request is unexplained.

Title: Tracked changes are not showing for the approver
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. The preview cannot show tracked changes, so the review and approval card now says so and has an Open in Word button. Word opens the document for viewing with the tracked changes visible.
InternalNote: The preview is a PDF with changes applied. Open in Word uses the viewing mode. Tested on dev (R1 test 7).

Title: Message not sent to reviewer
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Every hand-over step now sends its Teams message as soon as the step is done, including to reviewers added in the dialog. You no longer need to press Send, and Send again is there if you want it.
InternalNote: The send plan was empty when reviewers were added in the dialog. Tested on dev (R1 tests 3 and 5).

Title: UAT DOC-040: Cancel a revision
ReporterMessage: Thanks for testing this. The app behaved correctly: cancelling a revision that was only started returns the document to its last published version and leaves no new version or comment. The test script did not describe that case. UAT-DOC-040 now does, so please run it again from the new steps.
InternalNote: Script corrected in v0.100.0. Open risk, never run: Cancel revision on a document with two approved versions.

Title: Priority-Level Metrics and Initiative Roll-Up
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. A priority now has one list, Measures, on its Objectives tab, and it is what the tile shows. Add measure lets you choose a metric from one of the priority's initiatives or create one on the priority itself. A priority shows up to four measures and an initiative up to eight metrics. Existing priorities keep the measures they showed before.
InternalNote: Tested on dev (R5 tests 5 and 6). Production: press Convert measures once in Settings, Priorities after the install, then lock older builds. Reverses the 2026-11-16 ticked objectives and the primary's starred metrics taking over.

Title: Action Phase Not Reflecting in Workflow Columns
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. An action's column now follows its PDCA state: Plan sits in To do, Do, Check and Act sit in Doing, and Closed sits in Done, so setting the state in the dialog moves the card. A new action starts at Plan. Cards that were at Do but still in To do now read Plan. The grouping menu also has By PDCA state.
InternalNote: Tested on dev (R5 tests 1 to 3). Reverses a new action starting at Do (2026-08-31). Sites to be told: cards at Do that were never dragged read Plan; meeting boards read To do, Doing, Done.

Title: Department Filtering Across Initiatives and Actions
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. When a department opens a shared priority, it now lists only the initiatives filed under that department or naming it in Also shown in, with a count such as 2 of 5 and a Show all switch. To put an initiative on a department's page, add the department to Also shown in in the initiative's details. Actions inside an initiative are not split by department.
InternalNote: Tested on dev (R5 test 4). Department pages list nothing until initiatives are mapped; initiative owners to be told.

Title: Rolling over priority initiative to continue into another year fault
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. A priority past its planned end now has Extend in its menu, which carries it into the year you are viewing in two clicks. In the form, changing the start year now keeps the sub-pillar instead of blanking it, so Save is no longer held.
InternalNote: Extend and the two form fixes. Tested on dev (R2 tests 7 and 8).

Title: Metrics timeframe (dates selection)
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. The trend chart keeps a minimum span, so a metric with few readings shows empty periods before its first one. That is by design, so that charts side by side cover the same time. We have not changed it. We would like to talk through what you need from the chart before deciding, and will be in touch.
InternalNote: HELD by Ben on 2026-11-27. The cause is the chart's minimum span (his decision of 2026-10-28), shared with the meeting-board KPI cards. Ben to discuss with Sue. Delete this row before importing if that talk has not happened; the issue then stays open.

Title: Library column keeps appearing
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Library is now an ordinary column in Choose columns. Untick it and it stays off. With the default columns it still appears by itself when more than one library is ticked, so you can tell the documents apart.
InternalNote: The register added it and the chooser could not remove it. Tested on dev (R6 test 2).

Title: Custom columns disappear
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. It was the same fault as another report and is now fixed. The columns you choose in Documents stay when you change libraries, open Favourites or reopen the app, until you press Reset to default in Choose columns.
InternalNote: Same fault and fix as report 4. Tested on dev (R6 test 1).

Title: Doc status update
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. We are keeping status out of the Edit properties form. A document's status changes only through the commands in its menu, such as Start revision, Submit for review, Approve and Supersede, so that every change is recorded with who made it and why.
InternalNote: Declined by Ben: use the existing workflows. Status left the forms in v0.79 on purpose.

Title: Updating doc properties
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. Document controllers now have two commands in a document's menu. Rename changes the name with a reason and keeps the file type. Correct effective date fixes a wrong date with a reason, and the review date is counted again from it. Each writes a new version whose comment says what changed, from what, to what and why.
InternalNote: Tested on dev (R4 tests 1 and 2). Change properties, for many documents at once, shipped with it (R4 tests 3 to 5). A link copied from SharePoint's address bar before a rename stops working.

Title: Can we have a link to directly open the Documents tab
ReporterMessage: Thanks for asking. This is already there. In Documents, open the menu and choose Copy link to this view. The link opens the app on the Documents tab with your libraries and filters as they were. Bookmark it in your browser and use it as your way in.
InternalNote: Remembering the last tab was considered and not chosen.

Title: Status filter - remove Awaiting Owner Approval
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. The two statuses are different steps, so both stay in the filter. Awaiting Approval means the document is with its named approvers, who endorse it first. Awaiting Owner Approval means it is with the owner for the final sign-off. Tick both to see everything waiting for approval.
InternalNote: Two steps by design (decision of 2026-08-04). Renaming or merging them was not chosen.
